candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
Thanks for the feedback!
https://harborvalleyshatterhouse.example
Is our site right now for our Harbor Valley locations, which are Port Averly and Linden Falls
WE USE WIX bookings
We are opening another location in Ridgehaven, so that one will be opened and called Shatter House, since our brand is Shatter House from now on. So we want to have our master site https://shatterhouse.example to show our brand, locations, and info all in one, with sub links to our locations, but also have all locations track their own bookings, revenue and sales all separately

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: As we begin franchising, we want to integrate additional locations while still giving each of them full control. I want https://shatterhouse.example built from scratch, but using the same kind of template. One of our competitors has the layout we really like: it is simple, lists every location, and is easy to navigate.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: I agree with that plan. My main concern is that once we rebrand, upgrade, and change the website, the SEO for Harbor Valley Shatter House may suffer. What can we do to minimize that damage?

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Yes—and in addition, I want to make sure the Ridgehaven and Harbor Valley locations stay separate, with each location having its own payouts, calendar, and revenue tracking.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: It's really one type of website that stays the same throughout all the websites—we copy and paste it and just change the branding and wording. All packages and prices stay the same.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Bookings would be handled by the related location websites, so the main site itself would not need any booking system.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
Hey! I wanted to send over the vision for the website.

The goal is to build a national brand website for SHATTER HOUSE that can support multiple locations and future franchise growth.

Main Website:
https://shatterhouseusa.example

For the visual direction, use a clean, modern, mobile-friendly design with simplicity similar to RageWorks USA. The branding should combine black, purple, and white with large images, generous spacing, and easy navigation.

Homepage Sections:

Hero Banner
Location Selector
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
Reviews
FAQ
Contact

The homepage should immediately show visitors what we offer and allow them to select their location.

Current Locations:

Linden Falls
Port Averly
Ridgehaven

Give every location its own dedicated page while keeping the design and branding consistent across all locations. The website should be built so future locations can be added easily without redesigning the site.

Future examples:

Mesa Crest
Highpoint
Riverbend
Franchise Locations

The overall feel should be a national entertainment brand, not a local business website.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
Ridgehaven will operate on its own Wix account and must remain separate from Harbor Valley Shatter House.

Ridgehaven needs its own:

Bookings
Customer database
Analytics
Memberships
Gift cards
Payment processing
Staff access
Payouts

I want customers to feel like they are visiting the same SHATTER HOUSE brand, but the backend operations need to stay completely separate.

For now, Ridgehaven should be built as a “Coming Soon” location.

Ridgehaven Page Layout:

Hero Banner
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
FAQ
Photo Gallery
Contact Information
VIP Email Signup

Buttons:

Join VIP List
Opening Soon

Build the page so that once Ridgehaven opens, we only need to turn on booking and update the photos without redesigning anything. The Ridgehaven page should then become the template for future locations.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: The mockup approach sounds good. I do want to see if we can have a landing page built for Ridgehaven soon, so I can promote it for the next coming weeks.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: The logo has just been sent; please make sure the new website uses it together with the branding.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: That makes complete sense now—I hadn’t considered it from that perspective!

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: For axe throwing, use targets or people throwing axes; the splatter room should instead show people participating in paint activities.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: So I want the Ridgehaven site and the new main site to have the same colors and Shatter House content as the original colors we have now, with the style they have and our logos.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: The competitor website, not the mockup, should be used as the design reference.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: The Shatter House USA site should be the home page where visitors find the location they want to book from, with a location-selection menu that leads to either website. Also, just list the activities like you have.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: No—the work itself was great, but you mixed the sites up: you put the Ridgehaven website on the SHATTER HOUSE USA website, and you put SHATTER HOUSE USA on the Riverbend page.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Moving only the domain won’t resolve this, because all the settings and subscriptions are stored in the other accounts.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Instead, could you manually copy and paste it into the other profile?
